series.name: Sitting at the Feet of Rabbi Jesus

sermon.centralTheme: Jesus used Scripture and familiar Old Testament language to reveal His identity, including His claims as the Good Shepherd, the Son of Man, and God.
sermon.proposition: Jesus' own teaching and use of Old Testament Scripture reveal His divine identity.
sermon.summary: This legacy sermon examines Jesus' rabbinic style of teaching through Scripture and His claims concerning His identity. It highlights Matthew 21:16, Jesus as the Good Shepherd in John 10:14-15 in connection with Psalm 23, and the Son of Man language of Daniel 7:13-14. The sermon concludes that Jesus taught from Old Testament Scripture and identified Himself as the Good Shepherd, the Son of Man, and God, followed by a six-step salvation invitation.
